summary: Comprehensive backend (21 pytest tests) + frontend smoke testing of StagiaireConnect MVP. All backend endpoints pass. Landing page, login, dashboard, offers, feed verified UI-side.

issues: Two harmless 401 console errors from /api/auth/me probe on unauthenticated pages - consider only calling /me when a token exists in localStorage

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 916 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, offers, posts, messages, admin) for maintainability
/api/auth/me is hit on every page load even when no token present, causing 401 console noise - guard in AuthContext
No rate limiting on /auth/login or /auth/register - susceptible to brute force
set_cookie uses samesite='none' but only effective if frontend served cross-site over HTTPS - fine for prod, OK
/api/offers regex queries on title/description/domain not indexed - will degrade with scale
Application 'already applied' check is good; consider returning existing app_id
seed_data_creation: Used auto-seeded data; created TEST_Stage QA offer + TEST_post via tests (cleanup not strictly required as DB is reseeded only when <3 users)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, offers (incl. /offers/regions route ordering), applications, posts/like/comments, messages/conversations, contacts, notifications, dashboard for both roles, profile, admin endpoints, and /auth/session signature. Frontend login redirect to /dashboard works; offers and feed pages render seeded content. No business-logic bugs found.
